children.translated_text: and then lower him from the balance at the place corresponding to the mark. (10)
Having bound him with pledges, one should place the man upon it again;

children.text:
tasminn evaṃ kṛte sā cet kakṣe sthāpya suniścalā || 11
                                ||
children.translated_text: when this has been done thus, the beam should be held at the mark, perfectly still. (11)

children.text: tulito yadi vardheta śuddhaḥ syān nātre saṃśayaḥ |
children.translated_text: If when weighed he rises, he is declared pure — there is no doubt in this;

children.text: samo vā hīyamāno vā na viśuddho bhaven naraḥ || 12 ||
children.translated_text: if he remains the same or sinks down, the man is not acquitted. (12)
'By the synonyms of <s>dharma</s>, you are called <s>dhaṭa</s> (balance);

children.text: tvaṃ vetsi sarvabhūtānāṃ pāpāni sukṛtāni ca |
children.translated_text: you know the sins and merits of all beings;

children.text: tvam eva dhaṭa jānīṣe na vidur yāni mānuṣāḥ || 13 ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Dhaṭa</s>, you alone know what humans do not know.' (13)
'This person has been accused in a legal proceeding and is being weighed;

children.text: tad eva saṃśayāpannaṃ dharmatas trātum arhasi || 14 ||
children.translated_text: in this matter of doubt, you should justly rescue him.' (14)

children.text: ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi lohasya vidhim uttamam |
children.translated_text: Henceforth I shall declare the excellent procedure for the [ordeal of] iron;
the distance from one circle to another shall be thirty-two <s>aṅgulas</s> (finger-breadths). (15)
Thus with eight circles, two hundred and
twenty-four <s>aṅgulas</s> are declared by those who understand the true calculation. (16)

children.text: kalpitair maṇḍalair evam uṣitasya śucer api |
children.translated_text: When the circles have been thus arranged, for one who is purified and has fasted,
seven leaves of the <s>aśvattha</s> (sacred fig) tree should be wrapped around his hands with a thread. (17)
One should prepare a ball of heated iron weighing fifty <s>palas</s>;

children.text:
hastābhyāṃ piṇḍam ādāya śanaiḥ saptapadaṃ vrajet || 18
                                ||
children.translated_text: taking the ball with both hands, he should walk slowly seven steps. (18)

children.text: na maṇḍalam atikrāmen nāpy arvāk pādayet padam |
children.translated_text: He should not overstep a circle, nor place his foot short [of it],
nor should he drop [the iron] before reaching the full extent of the appointed ground. (19)
He who, concentrated in mind, has crossed the circles by this procedure

children.text:
adagdhaḥ sarvato yas tu sa viśuddho bhaven naraḥ || 20
                                ||
children.translated_text: and is unburnt in every respect — that man is declared pure. (20)

children.text: bhayād vā pātayate yas tv adagdho yo vibhāvyate |
children.translated_text: If one drops [the iron] out of fear and is [found to be] unburnt,

children.text: punas taṃ hārayel lohaṃ sthitir eṣā purātanī |
children.translated_text: he should be made to carry the iron again — this is the ancient rule;
the procedure for the fire ordeal should be conducted according to this rule. (21)
'O <s>Agni</s> (Fire), you move within all beings as a witness;
merit and demerit unknown to the world are known to you. (22)
The hidden sins and merits of humans

children.text: yathāvad eva jānīṣe na vidur yāni mānuṣāḥ || 23 ||
children.translated_text: you truly know, which mortals do not know. (23)
This person accused in a legal proceeding desires purification;

children.text: tad enaṃ saṃśayāpannaṃ dharmatas trātum arhasi || 24 ||
children.translated_text: you should justly rescue him who is beset with doubt.' (24)

children.text: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi toyasya vidhim uttamam |
children.translated_text: Next I shall declare the excellent procedure for the [ordeal of] water;
with a bow that is not too strong, one should shoot three arrows. (25)

children.text: madhyamas tu śaro grāhyaḥ puruṣeṇa yavīyasā |
children.translated_text: The middle arrow should be taken by a younger man [who runs to fetch it];

children.text:
pratyānītasya tasyātha sa viśuddho bhaven naraḥ || 26
                                ||
children.translated_text: if [the accused] is brought back before [the arrow is returned], that man is declared pure. (26)

children.text: anyathā na viśuddhaḥ syād ekāṅgam api darśayet |
children.translated_text: Otherwise he is not acquitted, even if he shows a single limb [above water],

children.text:
sthānād anyatra vā gacched yasmin pūrvaṃ niveṣitaḥ || 27
                                ||
children.translated_text: or if he moves from the spot in which he was first placed. (27)

children.text: striyas tu na balāt kāryā na pumān api durbalaḥ |
children.translated_text: Women should not be compelled by force [to undergo this ordeal], nor a man who is weak;

children.text: bhīrutvād yoṣito mṛtyuḥ kṛśasyāpi balāt kuryāt |
children.translated_text: a woman may die from fear, and a thin person may die if forced;

children.text:
sahasā prāpnuyāt sarvāṃs tasmād etān na majjayet || 28
                                ||
children.translated_text: suddenly all [of them] might perish — therefore one should not submerge them. (28)
In the middle of the water, having firmly grasped the man's thighs, [he is held] well-restrained. (29)
For distinguishing truth from falsehood, water and fire are the most clear [methods];

children.text: yataś cāgnir abhūd asmāt tatas toyaṃ viśiṣyate || 30 ||
children.translated_text: and since fire originated from water, water is considered superior [to fire]. (30)
Purification of the accused is performed by those who know the essence of <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: tasmāt satyena bhagavañ jaleśa trātum arhasi || 31 ||
children.translated_text: therefore, O venerable lord of waters, by truth you should rescue [this person]. (31)

children.text: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi viṣasya vidhim uttamam |
children.translated_text: Next I shall declare the excellent procedure for the [ordeal of] poison;

children.text: tulayitvā viṣaṃ pūrvaṃ deyam etad dhimāgame || 32 ||
children.translated_text: having first weighed the poison, it should be administered at the onset of the cold season. (32)

children.text: na pūrvāhṇe na madhyāhne na sandhyāyāṃ tu dharmavit |
children.translated_text: Not in the forenoon, not at midday, and not at twilight — [so says] the knower of <s>dharma</s>;
One should not enforce payment during autumn, summer, spring, or the rainy season. || 33 ||

children.text: bhagnaṃ ca dāritaṃ caiva dhūpitaṃ miśritaṃ tathā |
children.translated_text: That which is broken, split, smoked, or mixed,

children.text: kālakūṭam alambuṃ ca viṣaṃ yatnena varjayet || 34 ||
children.translated_text: <s>kālakūṭa</s> (a deadly poison) and <s>alambū</s> — one should carefully avoid such poisons. || 34 ||
The poison from the <s>Śārṅga</s> (Himalayan) region is recommended, endowed with fragrance, color, and potency;
The king should administer it to one accused of a grave offense, with the desire to ascertain the truth. || 35 ||
It should not be given to children, the sick, or the aged, nor to those guilty of minor offenses;

children.text:
viṣasya tu yavān sapta dadyāc chodye ghṛtaplutān || 36
                                ||
children.translated_text: One should give seven grains' weight of poison, soaked in ghee, to the accused. || 36 ||

children.text: viṣasya palaṣaḍbhāgād bhāgo viṃśatimas tu yaḥ |
children.translated_text: That which is a twentieth part of one-sixth of a <s>pala</s> (a unit of weight) of poison,

children.text:
tam aṣṭabhāgahīnaṃ tu śodhye dadyād ghṛtaplutam || 37
                                ||
children.translated_text: Diminished by an eighth part — that amount, soaked in ghee, should be given to the one undergoing purification. || 37 ||
Having been approved after touching <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> according to the prescribed procedure,
He should eat it while fasting, in the presence of gods and <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>. || 38 ||
If the poison is digested easily, free from violent effects and exhaustion,

children.text:
viśuddham iti taṃ jñātvā rājā satkṛtya mokṣayet || 39
                                ||
children.translated_text: Knowing him to be purified, the king should honor and release him. || 39 ||

children.text: tvaṃ viṣa brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ satyadharmaratau sthitaḥ |
children.translated_text: "O poison, you are the son of <s>Brahman</s>, established in truth and <s>dharma</s>;
Purify this man from sin — by truth, become nectar for him." || 40 ||

children.text: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kośasya vidhim uttamam || 41 ||
children.translated_text: Hereafter I shall declare the excellent procedure of the <s>kośa</s> (sacred water ordeal). || 41 ||
In the forenoon, for one who has fasted, bathed, and wears wet garments,
Who bears the sacred thread and is free from addiction — the drinking of <s>kośa</s> (sacred water) is prescribed. || 42 ||

children.text: yadbhaktaḥ so 'bhiyuktaḥ syāt taddaivatyaṃ tu pāyayet |
children.translated_text: The accused should be made to drink water consecrated to the deity in whom he has faith;

children.text: saptāhād yasya dṛśyate dvisaptāhena vā punaḥ |
children.translated_text: If any sign appears within seven days, or again within fourteen days,

children.text:
pratyātmikaṃ tu yatkiñcit saiva tasya vibhāvanā || 43
                                ||
children.translated_text: Whatever personal affliction occurs — that itself is the proof against him. || 43 ||

children.text: dvisaptāhāt paraṃ yasya mahad vā vaikṛtaṃ bhavet |
children.translated_text: If after fourteen days a great or abnormal change befalls him,
He should not be held liable by the wise, since the prescribed time has elapsed. || 44 ||
In cases of great offenses, for the lawless, the ungrateful, the cowardly and despicable,
For atheists, <s>vrātyas</s> (outcaste Aryans), and slaves — the <s>kośa</s> (sacred water) ordeal should be avoided. || 45 ||
In the manner prescribed, a knower of <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: dadyād rājābhiyuktānāṃ pretya ceha ca nandati || 46 ||
children.translated_text: The king who administers the five ordeals to the accused rejoices both in this world and the next. || 46 ||

children.text: na viṣaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyān na lohaṃ kṣatriyo haret |
children.translated_text: Poison should not be given to a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, nor should a <s>Kṣatriya</s> undergo the ordeal by iron,

children.text:
na nimajjyāpsu vaiśyaś ca śūdraḥ kośaṃ na pāyayet || 47
                                ||
children.translated_text: A <s>Vaiśya</s> should not be immersed in water, and a <s>Śūdra</s> should not drink the <s>kośa</s> (sacred water). || 47 ||

children.text: varṣāsu na viṣaṃ dadyāt hemante nāpsu majjayet |
children.translated_text: Poison should not be administered during the rainy season, nor should one be immersed in water during winter,

children.text: na lohaṃ hārayed grīṣme na kośaṃ pāyayen niśi || 48 ||
children.translated_text: The iron ordeal should not be conducted in summer, nor should <s>kośa</s> (sacred water) be drunk at night. || 48 ||
